subject.title: fix(session): stop repeated restart recovery after retry budget

question: Should this PR be the canonical landing path for the main-session restart-recovery fuse once the current head checks finish?
rationale: The latest patch appears technically sound, but it changes persisted session recovery state and intentionally stops automatic recovery for wedged rows, so a maintainer should own that upgrade and availability tradeoff.

options.title: Land this recovery-fuse PR
